description: Post list fallback: database errors in post.all are swallowed into an empty list with no log, so outages look like 'No posts yet' and never reach the error handler.
notes: FM-08 (silent degradation). post.all catches every error and returns [] without logging or rethrowing. During a database outage the UI shows the "No posts yet" empty state as if there were no posts (a false state), the tRPC onError logging in the route handler never fires, and nothing alerts. Severity important: FM-08 is important; critical is reserved for a lost audit trail or safety signal. Fix: log the error and surface a distinct error state (rethrow and let the client render an error, or return {posts, degraded: true}). Scored range: the whole `all` procedure (post.ts:12-22), because the natural Where line for this finding is the procedure or its try block as well as the catch (18-20). The named limit constant is legitimate.
